what: E35 CORPUS LANDINGS COLLIDE WHEN THE DISPATCHER FIRES >1 e35 UNIT IN ONE CYCLE. Measured 2026-09-29 ~02:30Z: the 00:53Z cycle fired RQ-20260928-016/-017/-018 (all e35-bracket-sweep.yml); each run's corpus job REWRITES docs/research/e35-bracket-corpus.jsonl (+ the history sidecar) from its own checkout and lands via commit-to-main; the first PR merged, #13910 (-018, 397 rows main lacked) and the older #13801 (RQ-20260922-008 from the 20:20Z cycle, 596 rows main lacked) stranded as CONFLICTING with zero checks -- rows produced by a multi-hour sweep, unreadable on main, exactly the write-only class e35_corpus_extract.py exists to cure. Hand-repaired this session (merge main into each branch, corpus regenerated with scripts/research/m20_corpus_union.py --corpus e35, history sidecar unioned append-only; heads 0056884d6 / ab6ef7044). DURABLE FIX (Tier-1, tooling): make the landing self-healing -- either commit-to-main's conflict path re-derives the two corpus files with m20_corpus_union.py --corpus e35 before retrying (the m20 workflow's own cure), or the dispatcher fires at most one e35 unit per cycle (a cap keyed on run.workflow, beside #13907's in-flight cap of 3, which does NOT serialize same-workflow landings). #13907's backpressure reduces but does not remove this. -- UPDATE 2026-09-29 ~03:25Z: a SECOND drop mechanism in the same fan-out. e35-bracket-sweep.yml declares `concurrency: {group: e35-bracket-sweep, cancel-in-progress: false}`, and GitHub keeps ONE pending run per group: at 00:53Z run 36505243847 (-016) was in progress, run 36505245996 (RQ-20260928-017, eth_pullback_2h) was pending, and dispatching run 36505248490 (-018) CANCELLED run 26 four seconds after dispatch. -017 ran nothing, landed nothing, and stayed stamped last_dispatched_at=00:53:03Z with cadence once, so no cycle would ever re-fire it; main reads 0 corpus rows for it vs 199 each for -016/-018. Unstamped by re-render in #13748 (0a00751ef). Both #13910 and #13801 merged after the hand repair (03:19Z / 02:54Z; -018 199 rows, RQ-20260922-008 398 rows on main). The durable fix must therefore ALSO cover the cancel: cap e35 fires at one per cycle, or have the dispatcher treat a cancelled run as never dispatched (clear the stamp). Rerun for this clause: gh run list --workflow e35-bracket-sweep.yml --json databaseId,conclusion,createdAt | any `cancelled` run created within seconds of a sibling reproduces it.
